decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the bridge is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The details of the external illumination design shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to the first public use of the bridge and permanently retained.

Condition : 5 - The details of the Closed Circuit TV facilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the bridge.. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to the first public use of the bridge and permanently retained.
description: Construction of pedestrian foot bridge and footpath link between Chiswick Park and Bollo Lane.
